title: MOOR Software Manufacturing Machine — compatibility alias
preserved_page0: Turn the MOOR software machine into an explorable fake 3D physical machine without allowing the physical metaphor to become fake logic. Bring the practical benefits of manufacturing—routing, work cells, fixtures, bills of material, serial travelers, quality control, maintenance, line stops, rework, change control and visible plant state—to software manufacturing, while making the process as accessible as possible.
preserved_intent: How should MOOR become a spatial software factory whose 3D machine makes invisible software production legible and operable, while every depicted machine state remains traceable to real executable logic, evidence and authority?
reason: Consolidated overlapping manufacturing blueprints into one canonical contract to reduce semantic/maintenance duplication while preserving prior references and intent.
migrated_concepts: truthful 3D factory as HMI/projection rather than authority
